Package an5.adapters.base

Class Metadata

java.lang.Object
an5.adapters.base.Metadata
public final class Metadata extends Object
The generated model's table names, columns and relations, registered at start-up.

The generated client calls setAdapterMetadata(Map) once before it hands out a table client. Nothing here reads the schema, so the adapter stays independent of the generator.

  • Method Details

    • setAdapterMetadata

      public static void setAdapterMetadata(Map<String,?> metadata)
      Replaces the registry with the metadata the generated client passed in.

      Called once per client, so it clears first: a second client for another schema in the same JVM must not see the first one's tables.

    • resolveModelKey

      public static String resolveModelKey(String modelName)
      The model's name as the metadata keys it, accepting a different capitalisation.

      The generated client registers tables under their PascalCase name while the metadata keys them in camelCase. A plain lookup would find no columns at all and silently skip isId — never generating the primary key.
